content.value: Make sentence with the following structures using the words given in brackets.
i.Subj. + Linking verb + Adj. Complement. (Look as verb)
ii. Subj. + Transitive verb + Object. (Deliver as verb)
iii. What + Subj. + Verb + Adv. of Manner + Verb + Adj. Complement. (Say and is as verb)
iv. Since + Subj. + Verb + Adj. Complement, Subj + Verb + Object. (is and hate as verb)
V. Though + Subj. + Verb + Adj. Complement, Subj. + Verb + Adv. (is and succeed as verb)
vi. Subj. + Verb + not only + object + but also + obj. (write as verb)
vii. Neither + Subj.+ nor + Subj. + Verb + Adv. of place. (progress as verb)

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
